_note: Config for emit_summit_matrix.py - the SUMMIT side of estMatrix for SOFI (the model's own estimates per snapshot, USD millions). The consensus side is map_sofi.json. Written Oct 26 2026 for the SOFI profile (docs/profiles/SOFI.md). The model has no EPS row: Summit EPS is EARNINGS / SHARES, computed in mkresults.py. prefer_source is DEFAULT before SEGM: OP_INCOME carries both and the SEGM annual (2026: 1,493.8) is a segment build-up that does not tie to the model Operating Income row (1,021.5).
_sign_note: MEMB is in THOUSANDS in the model and the dataset carries thousands too, so no scaling.
_vintages_note: The three model snapshots in the MCP. lastActual = the last period REPORTED in that file: the Feb 3 and Apr 29 files still carry 4Q25 as a projection (1,009.2 and 1,009.8 vs the reported 1,025.1), so both are pre-4Q25-print vintages; the Aug 5 file has actuals through 2Q26 (call Jul 29 2026).
